reason: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly to `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` without lower-bound validation or an upper cap, so negative values generate invalid negative SQL `LIMIT`/`OFFSET` clauses in PostgreSQL and arbitrary positive `limit` values are uncapped. The patch rewrote these lines and removed the `if group.automatic?` guard, exposing all groups to this unvalidated input.
